verdict.rationale: Twenty documents that API keys can be scoped to a specific role (Settings → Members → Roles → Assignment) to limit what they can access. That role-based access control is granular down to objects, fields, and records, so an agent's credential can be least-privilege. AI agents themselves can also be assigned roles that constrain their data access and actions. Missing for 10: details on key expiry, rotation and revocation, an explicit agent-specific credential flow (e.g., scoped auth for the MCP server), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
